title: Mission: The Printer
subtitle: Explore the printer and see how it makes a page.
summary: Meet the printer, identify its visible parts, and guide a page through the printing process.
activityInstruction: Load the paper, start the printer, and watch it work.

storyQuestions.success: The picture is inside the computer.
The children are making a picture.

storyQuestions.prompt: What do they add to the picture?
storyQuestions.success: They add bright colors, shapes and details.

storyQuestions.prompt: How does the finished picture look?
What does the child want to do?
storyQuestions.success: The child wants to take the picture home.

answers: The picture is stuck inside the screen
storyQuestions.success: The picture is stuck inside the computer screen.

storyQuestions.prompt: What do the children want the picture on?
storyQuestions.success: They want the picture on paper.

answers: Find a way to put the picture onto paper
storyQuestions.success: The mission is to put the picture onto paper.

quiz.success: The paper tray holds the paper.

quiz.prompt: What moves the paper through the printer?

quiz.success: The ink cartridges hold the colors.

quiz.prompt: Where does the printed page come out?
quiz.success: The printed page comes out of the output tray.

parts.label: Casing
parts.fact: The casing is the outer shell that protects the printer parts.
parts.help: Select the large outer body of the printer.

parts.label: Scanner Slot
parts.fact: The scanner slot is where a page can be placed for copying or scanning.
parts.help: Select the raised paper slot at the back.

parts.label: Control Panel
parts.fact: The control panel lets a person power the printer and choose what it should do.
parts.help: Select the buttons and screen on top.

parts.label: Output Tray
parts.fact: The output tray catches the printed page as it comes out.
parts.help: Select the tray extending from the front.
